# cato_custom_applications (Data Source)

The `cato_custom_applications` data source fetches information about custom applications with optional filters. Returns a list of custom applications matching the filter criteria.

## Example Usage

```terraform
## Providers ###
provider "cato" {
  baseurl    = "https://api.catonetworks.com/api/v1/graphql2"
  token      = var.cato_token
  account_id = var.account_id
}

### Data Source Usage ###

# Example: Read all custom applications
data "cato_custom_applications" "all" {}

# Example: Read custom applications by name
data "cato_custom_applications" "by_name" {
  name_filter = ["Internal CRM", "Legacy ERP"]
}

# Example: Read custom applications by ID
data "cato_custom_applications" "by_id" {
  id_filter = ["12345", "67890"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id_filter` (List of String) List of custom application IDs to filter by
- `name_filter` (List of String) List of custom application names to filter by

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) List of custom applications matching the filter criteria (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Custom application description
- `id` (String) Custom application ID
- `name` (String) Custom application name
